text.tspan: Host OS kernel (shared by all containers)
Each VM runs its own guest OS kernel
GBs · boots in tens of seconds · strong isolation
MBs · start in milliseconds · lighter isolation
A VM virtualises the hardware · a container virtualises the operating system
